entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I, uh, I need to return something. It's a helmet I just got a few days ago. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I just... I'm really disappointed.
I'm very sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference issue?

It's just... the color isn't what I thought it would be from the website. It looks so different in person. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it. I just really needed this money back for some unexpected bills.
I completely understand. Getting the right gear is important, especially when it comes to safety. Let me pull up your order. Can you please provide me with the order number?
Yes, it's VF886-012. I hope this isn't a problem. I feel bad calling.

Not a problem at all, that's what we're here for. Thank you. Okay, I see the Aero Road Helmet, delivered five days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, David. You have no idea what a help that is.

Of course. I'm happy to help. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just make sure the helmet is securely packed, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. Thank you again. I really appreciate it.
You're most welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Have a great day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
